issues.reason: The copular "this was the first time ..." is an identity, and the instruction set encodes identity by symbol reuse ("coreference is just symbol reuse, no extra link") with no identity head available and head-coining barred, so folding "this" onto the sealed reject event records the equation rather than dropping it — and the TEXT supplies no antecedent for "this" to link to.

Accurate that the scale slot degenerately repeats the ranked event's own class and that the comparison class ("first time a comptroller rejected a budget") is left unrestricted, but `(Ordinal <entity> <n> <scale>)` is well-typed here — an event witness is an individual and `reject` is the associated event lemma, exactly the `(Ordinal priya 1 respond)` shape — and the atom sits inside a non-factive seal, so nothing false or over-asserted reaches the KB and no licensed alternative exists.

gaps_confirmed: "this was the first / Nth time (that) S" — a clausal ordinal-occasion equative; Ordinal covers an ordinal NP ranking an entity, not a copular clause equating a discourse referent with the first occasion of an event type
new_gaps: Ordinal has no comparison-class slot (unlike Most's class argument), so a restricted ordering — first among comptroller-rejects-budget events, not among rejections at large — cannot be expressed

a demonstrative "this" whose antecedent lies outside the TEXT and is identified with the sealed proposition itself: the seal-projection rule for definite referents gives no guidance on whether its typing projects at top level under a non-factive matrix

a medium-of-communication PP ("in a news release") — the instruction set covers place (Location / LocatedIn) and framing/domain PPs, but not a vehicle-of-utterance PP; the parse's preposition-named `In` oblique is the nearest licensed form
notes: Top-level content is limited to true, well-typed atoms about the saying event; the whole reported proposition stays sealed under Theme as the non-factive route requires.
